settings.heading: Shipping Charges
settings.body: Shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on your delivery location and the items in your order. The applicable shipping fee will be displayed before you complete your purchase.

settings.heading: Dispatch & Delivery
settings.body:
• Orders are usually dispatched within 1–2 business days.
  • Delivery typically takes 4–7 business days, depending on your location.
  • Metro cities may receive orders sooner.
  • Once your order has been shipped, you’ll receive a tracking link via email and SMS (where available).

settings.heading: Cash on Delivery
settings.body: Cash on Delivery (COD) is available for eligible orders and serviceable PIN codes. COD availability will be confirmed during checkout.

settings.heading: Order Tracking
settings.body: You can track your order using the tracking link shared after dispatch. If you need assistance with your order, please reach out through our Contact page or the chat support available on our website.

settings.heading: International Shipping
settings.body: At the moment, we ship within India only. We’re working on expanding internationally—subscribe to our newsletter to be among the first to know when international shipping becomes available.

settings.heading: Delivery Timelines
settings.body:
While we strive to deliver every order within the estimated timeframe, delivery schedules may occasionally be affected by factors beyond our control, including courier delays, weather conditions, public holidays, or other unforeseen circumstances.

Please ensure that your shipping address, contact number, and other delivery details are accurate at the time of placing your order. THODA SOFT is not responsible for delays or additional delivery attempts resulting from incorrect or incomplete shipping information.

settings.intro: Everything you need to know about how and when your order arrives.
